title: What If Every Polar Bear Vanished? Arctic Foxes Would Feel It

scenes.text: What if every polar bear vanished? The Arctic's scavengers would lose their dinner.
A polar bear kills a ringed seal every three to five days at its peak.
It eats most of it and leaves about 30 percent behind.
Across about 26,000 bears, that's roughly 7.6 million kilograms of leftovers a year.
Arctic foxes can get up to two thirds of their winter food from carrion.
Researchers say at least 11 other species rely on those scraps, so the bears' loss would ripple down the food web.

description:
